scripts.dev: npm run build -w @metaverse/hub-sdk && npm run dev -w @metaverse/hub
scripts.build: npm run build -w @metaverse/hub-sdk && tsc -p server/modules/tsconfig.json && npm run build -w @metaverse/hub && node scripts/check-prod-bundle.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @metaverse/hub-sdk && npm run build -w @metaverse/hub-sdk && tsc -p server/modules/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @metaverse/hub && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
